Definition
[Mollification] 1. ch7:7.13\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0159 For $u\in L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega )$ and $0<h<\dist (x,\partial \Omega )$, define \begin{equation} \tag {7.13} u_h(x)=h^{-n}\int _\Omega \rho \! \left(\frac{x-y}{h}\right)u(y)\, dy. \end{equation} Then $u_h$ is smooth wherever it is defined. If $u\in L^1(\Omega )$ is extended by zero, the same formula defines a smooth function on $\mathbb R^n$.
